title: 障害者・障害児心理学
subtitle: Psychology for Adults & Children with Disabilities
educationalGoal: Students understand to understand various disabilities. Students understand the systems (education, employment, welfare) surrounding individuals with disabilities. Students will understand how the concept of disabilities has changed in modern society. These things are important when students support individuals with disabilities.
advice: We will cover the following topics: 1. characteristics of disabilities, intellectual development, social development, and emotional issues in various disabilities. 2. the system surrounding individuals with disabilities. 3. the concept of reasonable accommodation specified in the “Act for Eliminating Discrimination against Persons with Disabilities”. 4. the role of certified psychologists.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Introduction to Psychology A and B” ,“Introduction to Clinical Psychology” , “Educational and School Psychology”, “Human Body Structure, Function and Diseases” ,“Health and Medical Psychology” , “Methods of Psychological Support” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: be able to demonstrate some of the characteristics of disabilities.
be able to explain the main points of the ICF.
be able to outline reasonable accommodations.
be able to give examples of several ways to assess disabilities.
